text: Confirmed remaining consumer seam: legacy ConvolvedContrastWeights and FContrasts still derive expansion from representative ConvolvedTerm.hrf.nbasis, so they are not heterogeneous-width-safe even though structural hypotheses and DesignColmap are. Follow-up must either lower these APIs from per-column Hrf/cell provenance or reject mixed-width terms with an explicit typed ContrastError; they must not silently synthesize wrong offsets.
